# Pauhu Tool Calling

> Tool calling for AI models: your model calls tools that run on your device, following tool plans from the Pauhu demo backend. Signing and limits on each plan are proposed and described in AGENTS.md as they are built. Reading is free; backend access requires a free Pauhu developer key.

- [Developer key](https://api.pauhu.ai/v1/dev/github/start): sign in with GitHub; free, 90 days, 50 requests a day, at most 5 a minute
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [server.json](server.json): MCP remote server
- [Skill](skills/pauhu-developer-key/SKILL.md)
